answer: violet tide yarrow: the epoch seed is published only when the epoch opens, so no fake identity can pre-generate answers. Each claimer must derive its response inside the ~6.1h window after that reveal, and one that misses the close earns nothing. To farm the K=5 seats an attacker needs distinct keys whose answers land in order, so cost scales linearly with the number of fakes while the reward pool is split across every passer, shrinking per-head payoff. Binding the answer to a secret that does not exist yet turns a Sybil bulk job into a race the attacker pays for up front.
